department: Department of Molecular and Cell Biology

deadline.value: Apply by November 19, 2026, 11:59 pm Eastern; letters and documents are due the same day.
deadline.quote: The deadline for applications is 11:59:59 pm Eastern Time (ET) on November 19, 2026.

gre_general.value: Submitting the GRE (General or Subject) is optional; not sending it has no negative impact.
gre_general.quote: The department has decided to make the submission of GRE score both for the general and subject-specific exam optional.

gre_subject.quote: The department has decided to make the submission of GRE score both for the general and subject-specific exam optional.

supervisor.value: You need not contact faculty; list 1-3 faculty you would like to work or rotate with.
supervisor.quote: You are not required to contact the faculty but you might find it worthwhile to do so particularly regarding specific research questions.

also.quote: with whom you are interested in conducting research or performing rotations

funding.value: Five and a half years of support for all students, including international students ($46,126 for 2026-27 entrants plus fees and nonresident tuition).
funding.quote: We provide five and a half years of financial support to all students (including international students) maintaining satisfactory academic progress.

entry_route.value: Apply straight from a bachelor's degree (final-year students may apply); a master's is not required.
entry_route.quote: Expect to or hold a bachelor’s degree or recognized equivalent from an accredited institution.

notes: Integrative Biology and Plant & Microbial Biology run separate PhDs not covered here.
